posts.cooked:
Woo, I got a whole THREE letters answered today, my cup runneth over!
While it makes sense that this Captain Cosmic doesn’t run into Null in her first appearance, I’m glad they’ve confirmed that there would be a story with the two of them (and Materio) later on. And that there would be some nice emotional drama between the three of them, cos I live for that stuff.

I’m also very happy with the outcome of the Fleshchild discussion - all this talk of souls slightly confuses the issue because what a soul is and does seems to vary a lot depending on the comic in question, but it definitely seems like the more fully-formed fleshchildren are absolutely people. Nice to have a definitive, horrible answer

posts.cooked:
Finally caught up to this episode, and I’m super happy with it for the first time in a while. The podcast was “meh” to me for a long time, and I didn’t prioritize hearing it while I was busy with my job (I tried using it as background noise, but it was too distracting when I had work to do).

So, Galactra is developing into one of my favorite characters, and this Inversiverse version is awesome. I feel like her personality is very similar to Idealist, minus the kid aspects and anything Earth-specific (instead, I still regard her Narian species as being very akin to the Nebari in Farscape, as well as the Vulcans as mentioned here).

Really tempted to say something lewd about the Orbo situation, but I’ll hold my tongue. As effectively a creature of chaos myself, this version of Orbo would be basically paradise to me; it’s curious that he doesn’t get to be The Last Satellan for evil Jansa’s Enclave, but you can’t have everything.

Fleshchildren having a readable mind doesn’t prove that they’re fully human, because the mind can just be computer programming which broadcasts on the frequency Visionary scans. Visionary doesn’t detect souls or anything of that nature; there may even be something in the Sentinels universe which is neither the mind nor the soul, since both of those can be messed with by powers, but this mysterious something transcends all of that. In other words, if our real world exists in 3 dimensions, and souls we have no access to are in a 4th dimension, then the Sentinels universe has 5 dimensions, with souls and minds being physically real in the 4th.

posts.cooked:
Normal universe has Lawful Good Hugh Lowsley, Chaotic Neutral Leaning Evil Galactra, and Non Compos Mentis Nigel Infinitor. I feel like the Inversiverse has a Lawful Evil tyrant Hugh, someone trying to impose English law with the harshest most punitive interpretation, while Infinitor is more in agreement with the urgings of the Manifestations, and between those two evil’s, Galactra is Chaotic Good without actually being that different.

So the actual backstory of Elanabaz is just the movie Equilibrium.

Just for clarity I’m going to call this character La Capitana Cosmica, even though she’s not remotely Spanish.

They said Antarctica, but I think the ATM Machine joke demands that the FILTER Rehabilitation Center should be in the Sahara Desert.

I want fanart of Inverse Slamara as a sexy warrior Xarabian with seven veils and three scimitars.

I like the idea that inverse Rahazar is still incredibly exacting and entitled, that his plans are aimed at achieving good ends but only a very smart person like Parse can even tell.
